📖 Game script

Carolina lost starting cornerbacks Jaycee Horn and Mike Jackson to IR, which gives Detroit a HIGH grade: Jared Goff to Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jameson Williams. Williams draws overs from Brandon Anderson (70), Steve Fezzik (51.5) and Gilles Gallant (+200 to score). Jahmyr Gibbs was −501 to score at BetOnline on Oct 2 and is Andrew Erickson's touchdown rollover pick. The other side carries the slate's highest grade (HIGH, severity 10.2) with Brian Branch out for Detroit: Bryce Young to Tetairoa McMillan, Jalen Coker (questionable) and Darren Waller, whom PropStarz, Pat Fitzmaurice and Derek Brown all take over on receiving (Sean Koerner, +260 to score). Showers are likely through the game (NWS about 60%). Detroit by four, covering −3.5; 52 points, over 51.

🧠 Why the card leans this way

DET: BettingPros (−3), Pablo Planovsky of Action Network and Mike Florio (Lions 31–21). CAR: Sharp or Square (+3.5 and +3), Even Money (best bet from both hosts, Steve Fezzik and Ross Tucker, at +3.5), and Andrew Erickson, Steve Makinen of VSiN and Jason Radowitz of BettingPros, all at +3.5; Dave Tuley passes. Over: Action Network (Detroit team total), Andrew Erickson and Pablo Planovsky (51.5), and BettingPros (50.5 and 49.5, both now worse). Evan Abrams' primer has the Panthers on a 12-game run of covers after a straight-up loss, but two under systems fire (rising early-season totals, and a first-half under). Splits: DET has 64% of spread tickets and 71% of the money; the CAR moneyline has 12% of tickets and 19% of the money, no flag. The line went from the Action Network open of DET −3 to −3.5, and the total from 49.5 to 51. The side is close to a pass: the projection clears by half a point, against an expert count now 6–3 on Carolina. The lean is the receiver props: Williams and Waller receiving. Bookmaker's whole player-prop menu for this game was unpriced at the 10/03 capture, so check those prices before kickoff. Card: the DET moneyline is the Sunday-night cap on the Slot 3 Morning parlay and the Slot 4 Afternoon parlay. It's a placeholder for a live hedge, not a strong read (6–3 experts on Carolina). Jahmyr Gibbs 2+ TDs is in the 8b 2+ TD 3-leg. The island ladder is built Sunday (no Bookmaker props priced at capture).

⚠️ What breaks it

Rain is the main risk: if the showers arrive, both passing games slow and the over and the receiver props lose together. Young's turnovers would hand Detroit a two-score win. If Coker sits, Carolina's offense narrows to McMillan and Waller.
